scripts.simpan: git add -A && git commit -q -m "${MSG:-update pipeline}" -m 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' && git push -q
scripts.status: gh run list -L 3 && gh release list -L 3
scripts.ambil: rm -rf out/rilis && gh release download -p '*.mp4' -D out/rilis && F=$(ls out/rilis/*.mp4) && ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration:stream=width,height -of compact $F && for t in 3 20 40; do ffmpeg -v error -y -ss $t -i $F -frames:v 1 -vf scale=540:-1 out/rilis/f$t.png; done
scripts.tunggu: R=$(gh run list -L 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId'); gh run watch --exit-status $R > /dev/null || gh run view $R --log-failed | tail -30; gh release list -L 3
